overview: Server-side combat anticheats see the use-entity packet as the attack trigger. The 50-cloned-anticheat corpus splits into two families: modern simulation checks (Grim Reach, Kauri Hitbox, Artemis Reach2) that rebuild the client's view of the world and measure the exact attack vector, and classic statistical checks (Frequency KillAura, NCP fight.reach, AutoEye Reach) that score the attack angle, hitbox distance, and packet rhythm. The use-entity packet carries the entity id and action, so every killaura and reach check in the corpus keys off it.

checks.name: Reach (Grim)
checks.purpose: The reference modern reach check: verifies the attack vector against a simulated copy of the client's world state.
checks.how_it_works: Listens to the ATTACK packet (WrapperPlayClientAttack) and the INTERACT_ENTITY packet, then computes the distance from the player's interpolated eye position to the entity's exact collision box. Attack range is taken from the held item's attack range attribute, and the threshold is 3.0 + reach attribute with buffer. It cancels impossible hits outright and runs a cancel buffer for 4 hits after a flagged reach attack.
checks.detects: Reach cheats, killaura with extended range, hitbox-based auras, and any client that fakes attacks from beyond attribute reach.
checks.variations: Kauri (funkemunky-KauriV3) Hitbox check and Artemis Reach2 use the same simulation model; classic anticheats (NCP, AutoEye) instead compare the packet to the server's own entity positions with a tolerance.

checks.name: UseEntity adapter + fight.reach (NoCheatPlus)
checks.purpose: Classic 1.8 ProtocolLib adapter that forwards the use-entity packet into the fight checks.
checks.how_it_works: Wraps the NMS packet through ProtocolLib (with legacy reflection fallback for the action enum on 1.7 servers), builds a UseEntityData wrapper, and dispatches it to the fight reach, angle, direction, noswing and attackfrequency checks. The reach check measures the distance from the player's eye to the entity at attack time against the 3.0 block baseline plus the entity's hitbox radius.
checks.detects: Reach, killaura angle/direction, attack frequency, no-swing attacks.
checks.variations: AutoEye (heirteir-AutoEye) uses its own PacketPlayInUseEntity wrapper; Frequency and Degrade use WrappedPlayInUseEntity; SafeguardAC has a dedicated UseEntityPacketHandler.

checks.name: KillAuraA (Frequency)
checks.purpose: Classic 1.8 statistical killaura check over the use-entity stream.
checks.how_it_works: Reads the wrapped use-entity packet on every attack, tracks target rotations, and flags when the player attacks entities outside their field of view or with impossible turn patterns. Small, event-driven, typical of the 1.8 generation of anticheats.
checks.detects: Killaura that attacks without looking at the target, rotation-based aura patterns.
checks.variations: ThotPatrol KillAuraA, Azure AuraA/AuraB, Hydro KillAuraA and MC-Jinky-BasicAntiCheat KillAuraCheck are the same pattern on different event buses.
